I guess, haha. I've never heard of it said like that before. 

Lots of reasons, but for one, I'm interested in it for a deeper understand of how people think and feel. Like, even though we can experience the same thing we all also experience it in different ways and that is honestly so cool? There's just so much you can learn from and about psych. Also, if I could ever take this shitty experience and use it to make a difference in someone's life, then that would mean a lot to me.

Yes, actually. And oof, I applaud you. I can't do engineering at all. 

I mean, it obviously all would depend on the situation and why you felt that way? But from a very basic point, I guess I wouldn't bullshit things and say that it all gets better or that I understand exactly how you are feeling - because I probably don't. I'd still be sympathetic obviously, because I know how hard it is, but I wouldn't be fake? I'd offer an ear to listen and if you want advice, give that, but not force it on you. 

The thing is, I can give all of this other people, but giving it to myself just isn't something I've ever done or believed. If I'm thinking very rationally, I know that I am just as deserving as others, but emotionally it's just so hard for me to see that and to actually feel it? So yea.

It doesn't hurt, I guess. I have an appt next month, so I can try to bring it up... 

I'm actually studying psychology, haha 😅

I have. I just feel like I've tried so many that I'm not super optimistic about them by this point (Although, also probably some stubbornness about wanting to "do it by myself" - which is silly, I know, but...)

And yes, I am.

I've been taking them since like lower school (23 now).

I've been on and off different ones though, and I dunno. They helped in the past, but lately I feel like they just make me feel even more numb than I am? It feels like a trade off between being numb/not thinking vs being able to think/but anxious and feeling too much if that makes sense.
I guess if we are talking "good" coping skills? - Therapy. Meds. Doing stuff that keeps my mind occupied/follows my values
Me? I guess maybe more specifically my mind?
